Name: Machine Terrain Framework (and Extra Crop Configs - formerly Custom Tapper Framework)
Author: zombifier
Description:
This framework mod adds the ability to define:

[list]
[*]Big craftables that are placeable on trees, giant crops and water.[/*]
[*]Crops that are plant specific crops on water, using special items:
[list]
[*]A water planter to plant water crops on water, craftable with 20 wood[/*]
[*]A water pot to plant water crops on land, craftable with a garden pot. Available after the garden pot recipe is unlocked.[/*]
[*]These items are automatically unlocked if the player has any content packs that add aquatic crops.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Custom lightning rods that can produce their own output upon struck with lightning[/*]
[*]Custom planting pots that can accept their own list of crops[/*]
[*]Crops that can output multiple different items, can run trigger effects on plant, have growth time, crop output, and other factors influenced by conditions including nearby crops, and more.[/*]
[/list]

If you want to try them out, there's a content pack under Optional Files that make rice, taro and cranberries plantable on water as well as on land.

This is a framework mod that does nothing on its own.

Installation Instructions For Users:
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*]Download and extract the zip into the Mods folder inside the game's directory[/*]
[/list]

[url=https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/CustomTapperFramework]Source and modder guide[/url]

Mod integrations:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿: Should work, but let me know if there are issues.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13052]Tap Giant Crops[/url]﻿: Likely will NOT work, since they both do the same thing. Make sure to remove that mod if you're using it.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672]Junimatic[/url]﻿: Should also work. Please report any issues you encounter.[/*]
[/list]
